definition: Share of rounds by stage (seed, early, growth) per sub-layer (Appendix C venture measures).
name: Stage mix of venture rounds by sub-layer
unpublished_reason: Not measurable from free structured data: Form D has no round or series field, and Epoch's rounds (labs only) name the stage inside a free-text label; a stage mix by sub-layer needs PitchBook, Crunchbase or Dealroom (paid stubs off).
why_it_matters: A sub-layer full of seed rounds is being entered; one full of growth rounds is consolidating.
